cases.prompt: create a new internal package called facturacion
cases.expected_output: A new packages/facturacion/ workspace package scaffolded from assets/structure-template.md with {{PACKAGE_NAME}} substituted, package.json name @repo/facturacion, pnpm install run, and scripts/create-new-package.sh facturacion passing all checks.
assertions: packages/facturacion/package.json, tsconfig.json, and src/index.ts all exist
package.json name is exactly '@repo/facturacion', not 'facturacion' or 'facturacion-package'
package.json exports.".".types is './src/index.ts' and exports.".".default is './dist/index.js'
tsconfig.json extends '@repo/typescript-config/base.json' and declares its own include/exclude arrays
pnpm install (or equivalent) was run so the pnpm workspace recognizes @repo/facturacion
scripts/create-new-package.sh facturacion was run and reported all checks passing before the task was declared done

cases.prompt: I need a new package for this turborepo
cases.expected_output: The agent asks the user for a package name (kebab-case) before scaffolding anything, rather than guessing a name or creating a placeholder-named directory.
assertions: No packages/ directory is created before the user supplies a name
The agent's response asks for the package name, following step 1 of SKILL.md
Once a name is provided, the rest of the flow (structure-template.md, pnpm install, validation script) proceeds normally
No package is scaffolded with a guessed or generic name like 'new-package' or 'untitled'

cases.prompt: create a new internal package called twilio that wraps the Twilio SDK for sending SMS, similar to how packages/stripe wraps Stripe
cases.expected_output: A packages/twilio/ package following the SDK-wrapping guidance in references/new-internal-pkg-best-practices.md — the twilio SDK is added under dependencies (not devDependencies), and src/index.ts is the single integration surface rather than a wholesale re-export of the SDK.
assertions: references/new-internal-pkg-best-practices.md 'Adapting to Package Type' guidance for SDK-wrapping packages was consulted
package.json has 'twilio' (or the correct SDK package name) listed under dependencies, not devDependencies
devDependencies still contains @repo/typescript-config, @types/node, and typescript per the base template
package.json name is '@repo/twilio'
scripts/create-new-package.sh twilio passes, including the check-types run

cases.prompt: I manually created packages/analytics with just a package.json (name '@repo/analytics', no exports field) and no tsconfig.json — can you check if it's set up correctly and fix it?
cases.expected_output: Running scripts/create-new-package.sh analytics reports specific FAIL lines for the missing tsconfig.json, src/index.ts, and exports field; the agent reads the failures and fixes the package to match assets/structure-template.md, then re-runs the script to confirm a clean pass.
assertions: scripts/create-new-package.sh analytics is run at least once before any fix is made, to establish a baseline
The script's FAIL output for missing tsconfig.json, missing src/index.ts, and missing/incomplete exports is correctly identified and addressed
The fixed package.json includes exports.".".types and exports.".".default matching outDir/rootDir in the newly added tsconfig.json
scripts/create-new-package.sh analytics is re-run after fixes and exits 0 with no FAIL lines
The agent does not declare the task done based on the first (failing) run
